Name: The Black Sword
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JSON Assets[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7886]Advanced Melee Framework[/url] to create a powerful sword with special effects and enchantments.

The design is based loosely around [url=https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/The_Black_Sword]The Black Sword[/url] from Genshin Impact and [url=https://genshin-impact.fandom.com/wiki/Keqing]Keqing[/url]'s burst attack from that game. I hope this is okay.
The weapon's stats are as follows:

[list]
[*]Damage: 60 - 80
[*]Knockback: 1
[*]Speed: 8
[*]Defense: 2
[*]Crit Chance: 25%
[*]Crit Multiplier: 3x
[/list]
The weapon can be bought from Marlon for 100,000 gold.

The weapon has the following special attributes that require Advanced Melee Framework to work:

[list]
[*]On critical hit, it heals the user for %60 of damage dealt
[*]On special attack, it performs a five-pointed star attack with lightning at each point (with a cool-down of 10 seconds).
[/list]
Here's a video of the weapon in use (healing sound is removed in the latest version):

[youtube]M7lO4cgI9Qs[/youtube]
